content.value_statement: Generic dashboards make products feel interchangeable and harder to scan. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to design focused product interfaces with clear systems.
actual_capabilities: Guides domain exploration before selecting an interface direction.
Defines color, surface, spacing, typography, depth, and state principles.
Checks designs with swap, squint, signature, and token tests.
Supports reusable project pattern memory through a local system file.
Separates product interface work from marketing page design.
limitations: Does not cover landing pages, campaigns, or brand marketing design.
Needs product context to avoid generic interface decisions.
Does not replace accessibility, performance, or user testing reviews.
Pattern memory depends on user approval and project-local files.

use_cases.title: Design a Focused Dashboard
use_cases.description: Explore the product domain, choose a signature direction, and define layout, color, and hierarchy before building.

use_cases.title: Improve an Admin Panel
use_cases.description: Audit spacing, surfaces, controls, states, and typography so the interface feels intentional and consistent.

use_cases.title: Standardize Product UI Patterns
use_cases.description: Capture reusable interface decisions so future screens follow the same product logic and visual system.

prompt_templates.title: Explore an Interface Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new product screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the interface-design skill to explore the domain for a new product interface. Identify the user, task, color world, signature element, and defaults to reject.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Dashboard System
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a structured dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dashboard with a clear navigation model, surface hierarchy, spacing scale, control states, and domain-specific visual language.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this interface for generic patterns, weak hierarchy, inconsistent tokens, missing states, and unclear product intent. Recommend concrete changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Reusable Interface System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for repeatable product design
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract reusable patterns from this interface and propose what should be saved for future screens, including spacing, depth, components, and visual direction.

output_examples.input: A product team needs a maintenance dashboard for field technicians.
output: Domain focus: equipment status, dispatch priority, site constraints, and maintenance history.
Design direction: a dense scan-first interface with restrained alerts and operational color choices.
Checks: hierarchy, signature elements, token language, and non-generic layout decisions.

output_examples.input: An engineer asks for a review of an existing settings page.
output: Audit result: unclear hierarchy, weak focus states, and inconsistent spacing reduce usability.
Recommendations: use a smaller spacing scale, clearer control states, and calmer surface separation.

output_examples.input: A founder wants future product screens to feel consistent.
output: Saved patterns should cover direction, depth, spacing, and repeated component behavior.
Future screens should reuse these choices unless the user approves a new direction.

best_practices: Start with the product domain and user task before choosing layout or style.
Define surface, spacing, typography, color, and state rules as one system.
Run craft checks before showing the user the final interface.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a standard dashboard template before exploring the product context.
Do not use random colors, spacing values, shadows, or border styles.
Do not save one-off experiments as reusable interface patterns.

faq.question: What kind of work is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for product interfaces such as dashboards, admin panels, SaaS apps, tools, settings screens, and data views.

faq.question: Can it create marketing pages?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly excludes landing pages, marketing sites, campaigns, and similar promotional design work.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: It guides interface decisions and implementation details, but the host AI agent still performs the coding work.

faq.question: How does it reduce generic AI output?
faq.answer: It requires domain exploration, a signature element, rejected defaults, and checks against common template patterns.

faq.question: Does it store design memory?
faq.answer: It can propose saving reusable interface patterns in a project-local system file after user approval.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
